arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
img=Image.open('.tmp/agent_shots/settings_cassette3.png')
# crop lower portion where DISPLAY group likely starts
for i,(y0,y1,name) in enumerate([(330,520,'crop3_mid'),(330,580,'crop3_mid2'),(450,680,'crop3_lower')]):
    crop=img.crop((0,y0,1278,y1))
    out=f'.tmp/agent_shots/{name}.png'
    crop.save(out)
    print('saved',out)
